text: Update23 September 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com Starfall: Discovery (1.3.6) | Patch Notes Patch 1.3.6 is FINALLY out! Discover it all here. New Weapon Type: Scythes (Preview) Scythes have the following stats by default; Magic Attack, Melee Attack and Healing Power. All three stats have equal scaling and are ~11% weaker than single-stat weapons. Scythes have 3 hidden procs, one for each damage type and healing. — Melee Magic Healing Proc Lifesteal Timewarp Nui’s Celerity Trigger Dealing melee damage to an enemy unit Dealing magic damage to an enemy unit Healing any unit Effect Heals the user for 50 + 180% Healing Power. Affected by Healing Critical Rate, Critical Bonus, and healing increases. Resets the cooldown of certain spells, including their Ancestral and Enlightened variants. Completely removes the cast time of certain spells. Chance on Hit 20% 5% 8% Duration — — 8s Cooldown 30s 180s 50s Crafted Scythes have been added. They use Wooden Wisps and have the following variants: Autumn (upgradeable) Flame Life Meadow Meteor Sunset Wave Hasla Emerald Scythe has been added with the following stat distribution: Strength, Intelligence, Spirit Hybrid 2H gems have been added: Gale Lunagem Harmony: Clear (T1): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +1.4% Vivid (T2): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +2.1% Lucid (T3): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +3.5% Can be obtained from Mistsong Summit’s Mistsong Reticules, or those from crafting up lower tier sealed lunagems acquired from Mistsong Summit. Lucid version added to the loyalty shop for 100 loyalty. Enlightened Ayanad Accessories (Preview) Ayanad accessories can now be Enlightened using an Enlightened Runestone. Dormant Runestones can be acquired from opening Library Research Bundles. Enlightened Runestones are crafted using the following recipe: 1x Dormant Runestone 5x Starlight Archeum Essence 50x Blue Salt Hammer 1x Ayanad Starlight Blessing which requires the following for one: 2x Acid Vessel 2x Complete Cursed Armor 100x Earthmana Leaf 25x Prismatic Diamond 1x Ayanad Accessory Scroll 5x Black Pearl Using an Enlightened Runestone on any Ayanad accessory will imbue that accessory and transform it into its Enlightened version. Runestones are single-use. In addition to the Ayanad accessories, certain world boss and dungeon accessories can also be Enlightened. Here’s the full list: Crimson Watch Ring Crimson Watch Earring Assassin Ring Assassin Earring Assassin Necklace Soothsayer Ring Soothsayer Earring Soothsayer Necklace Sorcerer Ring Sorcerer Earring Sorcerer Necklace Berserker Ring Berserker Earring Berserker Necklace Storm Caller’s Hoop Handle With Care Titan’s Chain Carmila’s Memory In order to Enlighten the accessories listed above, you first need to craft an Enchantment Scroll. Each accessory has its own unique Enchantment Scroll but the means to obtain them are the same. To obtain an Enchantment Scroll, you need: 1x Dormant Runestone 1x Blank Regrade Scroll 1x The accessory you wish to Enlighten. (To make the process easily explainable, we will use the Berserker Ring as an example. As stated before, the process is exactly the same for all accessories past this point.) This recipe consumes the accessory used, the grade does not matter and results in an Enchantment Scroll. Steps to Enlighten your unique non-Ayanad accessory: Acquire a Berserker Enchantment Scroll by crafting the recipe above. Note: Every piece of a “set” gives you the same Enchantment Scroll. Eg. Using a Berserker Ring, a Berserker Earring or a Berserker Necklace in the crafting recipe will result in a Berserker Enchantment Scroll. Acquire any variant of an Enlightened Ayanad Ring. Eg. The type of Enlightened Ayanad accessory you’ll need depends on which piece of accessory you’re trying to acquire. Our example is a Berserker Ring, so we need an Enlightened Ayanad ring of any variant. Use the Berserker Enchantment Scroll on the Enlightened Ayanad accessory. Using the Berserker Scroll on an Enlightened Ayanad earring will result in a Berserker Earring, using the Scroll on a ring will result in a Berserker Ring and using it on a necklace will result in a Berserker Necklace. And you have your Enlightened Berserker Ring. As a reminder, the grade of the accessory used in this process is discarded. Only the grade of the Enlightened Ayanad accessory that is being imbued with the Enchantment Scroll is kept. Enlightened Ayanad accessories now have 2-set effects. Equipping a ring and an earring of a matching variant will allow you to utilize a unique set bonus. On top of needing a matching set of an Ayanad ring and earring, you also need a matching Lunacharm slotted on your costume. Here are all of the 2-set effects for all 7 Enlightened Ayanad accessory variants: Lightning Earring + Lightning Ring + Lightning Charm: 50% Increased gliding speed +4 second to glider recovery time Earth Earring + Earth Ring + Earth Charm: +2 Maximum Abyssal Charge Meadow Earring + Meadow Ring + Meadow Charm: Abyssal Charges no longer decay Life Earring + Life Ring + Life Charm: Increases the rank of the following skills by +1: Precision Strike Earthen Grip Shield Slam Thwart Hell Spear Deadeye Freezing Earth Stalker’s Mark Ode to Recovery Renewal Note: This bonus does not yet currently affect Ancestral or Enlightened variants. Wave Earring + Wave Ring + Wave Charm: +10 Post-Cast mana regen Flame Earring + Flame Ring + Flame Charm: Restore 100 HP upon blocking, parrying or evading any attack Gale Earring + Gale Ring + Gale Charm: Critical strikes increase movement speed by 3%, stacks up to 10 Each Charm requires the same 4 ingredients on top of requiring a unique ingredient depending on the variant of the Charm. Here’s what the 4 common ingredients are to craft any Charm: 2x Starlight Archeum Essence 5x Misagon’s Crystal 1x Accessory Regrade Scroll 2x Imperfect Sigil acquired from the following recipe: 5x Prime Lunarite 10x Gilda Dust 1x Anthalon’s Crimson Hallow Note: This recipe results in 5 Imperfect Sigils. On top of the 4 common ingredients listed above, each Charm requires one unique ingredient of their own. Flame: 25x Saffron Earth: 10x Pure Gold Ore Wave: 1x Chilled Seafoam Life: 1x Wild Ginseng Gale: 100x Lily Lightning: 1x Thunderstruck Log Meadow: 100x Aloe Enlightened Library Accessories have unique 3-set bonus effects. Unlike Enlightened Ayanad 2-set bonus effects, you do NOT need a Charm to activate these effects. As a note, with the exception of Berserker, the 3 Library accessory sets have their names changed upon being Enlightened. Sorcerer > Arcanist Soothsayer > Oracle Assassin > Shadow The list of sets and bonuses are as follows: Berserker Ring + Berserker Earring + Berserker Necklace: Taking any damage has a chance to trigger Berserker’s Instinct: +1000 Attack Speed 30s duration 3m cooldown Shadow Ring + Shadow Earring + Shadow Necklace: While equipped, the user is granted a new passive, Ethereal Shift: Movement speed increased by 30% while stealthed Increases the duration of stealth from mount abilities by +30 seconds. Arcanist Ring + Arcanist Earring + Arcanist Necklace: Grants the Arcane Mastery passive: Gain 100% maximum mana Grants the Arcane Absorption passive: 50% of incoming damage is converted into mana burn Eg. If you were about to take 1000 damage, you would instead take 500 damage and lose 500 mana. Note: This effect functions as healing. You will take 1000 damage regardless but lose 500 mana to restore 500 HP. This heal is affected by healing bonuses but has an extremely low scaling value. Oracle Ring + Oracle Earring + Oracle Necklace: Grants the Fate’s Edict passive: 20% mana cost reduction -30% cast time You have 2 new types of Lunafrosts to slot on the new Enlightened Accessories. By default, Enlightened Accessories only have their equip effects and not their stats. Eg. An Enlightened Wave earring will NOT have intelligence by default but will still have - damage reduction. This goes for Enlightened necklaces as well. Here are the Lunafrosts the new Enlightened Accessories will accept: Earrings and Rings Perfect Lunasigils: Flame: +35 Strength Earth: +35 Stamina Wave: +35 Intelligence Life: +35 Spirit Gale: +35 Agility Desert: +20 Strength, +20 Stamina Sunset: +20 Strength, +20 Intelligence Meteor: +20 Strength, +20 Spirit Lightning: +20 Strength, +20 Agility Lake: +20 Stamina, +20 Intelligence Stone: +20 Stamina, +20 Spirit Squall: +20 Stamina, +20 Agility Meadow: +20 Intelligence, +20 Spirit Tidal: +20 Intelligence, +20 Agility Mist: +20 Spirit, +20 Agility Necklaces: Perfect Lunasigils (Same as listed above) OR Radiant and Hollow Lunamarks: Each skill tree has one Radiant and one Hollow Mark. This means 20 Marks in total. (10 Radiants, 10 Hollows) Imbuing your Enlightened necklace of any variant (including boss and dungeon necklaces) will grant you the corresponding Enlightened Skill. Eg. Slotting a Radiant Auramancy Mark on your Enlightened Necklace will grant you Radiant Meditate. For more information on all of the Enlightened Skills, please refer to the Enlightened Skills part of the patch notes. To clarify, Enlightened necklaces will keep their equip effects in all cases and can either have a Perfect Lunasigil or a Radiant/Hollow Mark. Not both. All Radiant Marks and all Hollow Marks share the same crafting recipe: Hollow Marks: 2x Imperfect Lunasigil 3x Prime Lunarite 5x Misagon’s Crystal 2x Moonlight Archeum Essence Radiant Marks: 2x Imperfect Lunasigil 3x Prime Lunarite 5x Misagon’s Crystal 2x Moonlight Archeum Essence As a final note, all Enlightened Accessories have slightly higher equip effect values compared to their non-Enlightened counterparts. Since there are about 40 Enlightened Accessories, each with their own scaling factors, we encourage our players to use the in-game Item Encyclopedia to see all of the new values for themselves. New Profession: Taming (Preview) Taming has been added as a new profession. Taming is the first custom profession that is being added to Archeage Classic. This profession will fall under “Special” Category and revolve around taming wild beasts out in the world, either using these as your own personal mounts, trading them with other players or exchanging them for materials used in various different crafting recipes. There are two ways to find wild beasts to tame. 1- By roaming Erenor and finding wild, wandering tameable beasts 2- By instigating tameable beasts to come out of their hiding by slaughtering their kind Almost every zone in Erenor has wild beasts to tame, so explore and catch them all! To start taming, you need a Tamer’s backpack, a simple leather-bound bag filled to the brim with crucial tools to tame beasts. Currently, there are 3 tiers of backpacks: Greenhorn’s Backpack: Requires 0 Taming proficiency to use To craft this backpack, you need: 5x Vita Seed 10x Leather 10x Apple Wrangler’s Backpack: Requires 80.000 Taming proficiency to use To craft this backpack, you need: 1x Greenhorn’s Backpack 10x Hay Bale 10x Apricot 10x Orange 10x Pomegranate 200x Whistle of the Wild (These will be explained later) Herdmaster’s Backpack: Requires 200.000 Taming proficiency to use To craft this backpack, you need: 1x Greenhorn’s Backpack 10x Royal Seed 5x Wind Spirit Leather 100x Cherry 100x Jujube 100x Coconut 600x Whistle of the Wild Taming is similar to fishing in terms of mechanics but has a little more depth. When you attempt to tame a wild beast you will notice its HP drop drastically at first. That’s your progress bar to tame the beast. The beast may display several “moods” during the taming process. React in time with the correct action and you will gain its trust and come closer to taming it. When you’ve successfully filled the beast’s HP bar, it will accept you as its new owner and you will gain a Mysterious Beast. The type of beast is determined by the creature you’ve just tamed. If it was a boar, you’ll get a Mysterious Boar. When you’ve successfully filled the beast’s HP bar, you will receive a Mysterious Beast in your inventory. There are a few extra modifiers fully dependent on luck, they are: Rarities: Your mysterious boar can currently be one of three grades: Grand > 9.0 m/s Arcane > 11.5 m/s Celestial > 11.7 m/s Personalities: Your mount can have one of four personalities: Ferocious Hasty Resolute Spunky These personalities determine your mount’s last three abilities. The first 2 abilities of each mount are unaffected by personality and are unique to each species. Species: As stated above, species determine the mount’s first 2 abilities. Once you have your Mysterious Beast, there are a couple of things you can do with it. Let’s use a real example for the sake of simplicity. We just received an Arcane Mysterious Boar from taming a wild boar. Right now your Arcane Mysterious Boar is not yet a mount, it is a sealed, tamed beast. Right now, the only thing you know about it is its base movement speed and its first 2 abilities. In its current form, you may trade it with other players or place it on the auction house. If you prefer to keep it to yourself as a mount then you can unveil your mount to reveal its personality. Upon unveiling your Arcane Mysterious Beast, it can have any of the 4 personalities available. Ferocious Hasty Resolute Spunky As stated earlier, the first 2 abilities of your mount are predetermined by its species. The last 3 abilities are determined by its personality. Each personality has 3 abilities. From the 3rd ability slot to the 5th, each slot is a 50/50 between one ability from its personality pool and one ability from its species. With these in mind, I’m sure you can imagine how many different combinations there are available. Without listing all available abilities, you can think of each personality as a unique archetype: Ferocious has abilities that are offensive and damage oriented. Hasty abilities are focused on speed and covering a lot of distance. Resolute’s ability pool is all about being tanky and surviving as long as possible. Spunky has abilities that are mostly movement oriented. Your last option with your new mount is to release it back into the wild using a Wildcaller Flute, available for purchase from any stablehand. When a mount is released using the Wildcaller Flute, you are granted Whistles of the Wild. The exact amount varies depending on the rarity of the mount released. On average: Grand mounts yield ~3 Whistle of the Wild Arcane mounts yield ~5 Whistle of the Wild Celestial mounts yield ~10 Whistle of the Wild These whistles are crucial to taming as almost every crafting recipe requires them in some amount. On top of already extremely customizable mounts, we have added new custom mount armor sets as well. Each set has 3 pieces; Shaffron (head slot), Saddle (body slot) and Cannonguards (legs slot). And each piece has 3 tiers; base, Regal and Ornate. Currently, there are 4 sets available: Support Stout Survey Swift These sets have unique 3-set bonuses available. Support: Increases mana Regen of all allies, pets and summons within a radius around the mount. Mana regen value and range increases with each tier. (base, Regal, Ornate) Stout: Decreases received damage of the mount and increases damage dealt by the mount. Values increase with each tier. Survey: Increases movement speed when overencumbered. Speed bonus increases with each tier. Swift: Mount ability cooldowns are reduced. The reduction goes up with each tier. Each armor slot requires different materials to craft, however materials do not change between set types. Basic Shaffron (T1): 100x Whistle of the Wild 10x Fabric 10x Duck Down 5x Mysterious Garden Powder Regal Shaffron (T2): 1x Basic Shaffron (T1) 200x Whistle of the Wild 4x Beautifully Colored Fabric 200x Goose Down 50x Earthmana Leaf Ornate Shaffron (T3): 1x Regal Shaffron (T2) 300x Whistle of the Wild 1x Cloudspun Fabric 300x Glossy Feather 3x Lord’s Coin Basic Saddle (T1): 100x Whistle of the Wild 10x Leather 10x Goat Wool 5x Mysterious Garden Powder Regal Saddle (T2): 1x Basic Saddle (T1) 200x Whistle of the Wild 4x Fine Leather 100x Yata Fur 50x Earthmana Leaf Ornate Saddle (T3): 1x Regal Saddle (T2) 300x Whistle of the Wild 1x Wind Spirit Leather 200x Bear Fur 3x Lord’s Coin Basic Cannonguards (T1): 100x Whistle of the Wild 10x Iron Ingot 10x Gold Ingot 5x Mysterious Garden Powder Regal Cannonguards (T2): 1x Basic Cannonguards (T1) 200x Whistle of the Wild 4x Sturdy Ingot 10x Archeum Ingot 50x Earthmana Leaf Ornate Cannonguards (T3): 1x Regal Cannonguards (T2) 300x Whistle of the Wild 1x Sunridge Ingot 20x Anya Ingot 3x Lord’s Coin Alongside armors, there are also new consumables able to be crafted using taming proficiency, These include: Goldscale Dew Stew: -Restores 5.000 mana to your mount over 15 seconds. 1x Hearty Soup 1x Whistle of the Wild 3x Lotus 2x Bay Leaf Greenlord’s Apple: Heals 10.000 health to your mount over 15 seconds. 1x Deluxe Sandwich 1x Whistle of the Wild 10x Apple 1x Scented Leaf Ba-Mana Smoothie Instantly restores all of your mount’s mana. 1x Kraken’s Might 1x Whistle of the Wild 3x Milk 3x Banana Cherry Bomb Instantly fully heals your mount. 1x Nui’s Nova 1x Whistle of the Wild 3x Cherry 3x Impatiens Orange-U-Glad Your mount gains +5.0 movement speed for 7 seconds. 80s cooldown. 1x Flaming Pinion 1x Whistle of the Wild 3x Scented Leaf 5x Pepper 5x Orange 5x Vanilla With the release of 1.3.6: Discovery, there are currently 19 tameable beasts scattered around Erenor. These beasts are as follows: Ant Bat Bladewing Boar Crab Crayfish Earth Elemental Grub Honeybee Jabberwock Mandragora Mantis Owl Razorbeak Scorpion Skyfin Spider Starfish Turtle Taming is the first custom profession and the Archeage Classic team is very excited to hear your feedback on everything. As a final note, taming will continue to be expanded upon in the future with many more new beasts to tame, new personalities and higher rarities. If you have any ideas you would like to suggest, please feel free to make a game suggestion thread in our discord server. Primal Anthalon (Preview) Primal Anthalon is the latest Primal world boss added to Archeage Classic. For these patch notes, we have decided not to explain all of the new mechanics Primal Anthalon now has, instead focusing on the new Primal Kyrios armor set and set effects. However, that being said, we would like to briefly mention and name a few of the new mechanics: Festival of the Dead has gotten a significant boost. It is said Anthalon has gotten his hands on some particularly strong undead minions. Anthalon has infused his signature ability, Absorb Mind, with the power of the Comet. It is now deadlier and much more potent. Now powered up with powerful undead chanters chanting words of binding, it will be quite a challenge to break free of his grasp. With the Comet’s influence strong on Exeloch, Anthalon has managed to summon spires of immense power, biding his time to gather his strength further. Whatever he may be up to, is no good… Added Primal Kyrios armor set. Ilvl has been boosted to 62. (Equivalent to Ayanad) Stat allocations on certain pieces have been adjusted. Primal Kyrios Shirt is now full Stamina rather than Stamina / Intelligence Primal Kyrios Sleeves are now full Intelligence rather than Stamina / Intelligence Primal Kyrios Gloves are now Stamina / Intelligence rather than full Intelligence Primal Kyrios Sash is now full Intelligence rather than Stamina / Intelligence Primal Kyrios Pants are now full Stamina rather than Full Intelligence. 4 and 7-set effects have been adjusted. 4-set: Grants 700 toughness. There’s a low chance to trigger Anthalon’s Necromantic Flame upon receiving damage. 7-set: Decreases damage received by 4.5% Has a low chance of triggering Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb upon dealing any damage. Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb is a new ability. Upon triggering Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb, the player is granted “Instant Acceleration for 3 minutes. During the 3 minutes, the player can cast Instant Acceleration to teleport to any target within 20 meters. Upon teleportation, the surrounding area is swept in frost, snaring all nearby enemies in an 8m radius for 4 seconds. After teleporting, the player is given 5 seconds to use “Absorb Mind”, Anthalon’s signature ability. On use, Absorb Mind will grab up to 10 enemies within 15 meters and lift them for 4 seconds. There are a few key differences between Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb and regular Mind Absorb: Shrug it off no longer breaks the user free from the lift. Enemy players lifted by Mind Absorb are immune to all damage for the duration. Mana burn and landing trip are not included. The caster of Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb is CC immune during the duration. Cooldown 180s. There are two ways to acquire Primal Kyrios armor. Upon being defeated, Primal Anthalon will drop a Primal Hallow and a piece of Primal Kyrios armor. Players are able to use the following crafting recipe to upgrade their Corrupted Kyrios armor into Primal Kyrios. 1x Corrupted Kyrios armor 1x Blazing Cloudspun Fabric 1x Complete Cursed Armor 1x Acid Vessel 1x Primal Hallow Note: The grade of the Corrupted Kyrios armor used is kept however any gems and tempers will be lost in the process. Recipes for all pieces of armor are identical. Note: Primal Kyrios armor is bind on equip. Meaning upgrading a Corrupted Kyrios armor through the crafting recipe will unbind the armor until re-equipped. We believe Primal Anthalon will be the most difficult boss in Archeage Classic but we believe the difficulty comes from new, interesting, custom mechanics rather than being a frustrating “bullet sponge”. We hope all of you will enjoy Primal Anthalon as much as we enjoyed designing and testing him. Enlightened Skills (Preview) Battlerage Radiant Terrifying Roar Strengthens all allies within 5m for 12 seconds. Reduces the duration of crowd control effects by 30%. 30s cooldown. No longer increases CC duration of nearby enemies. The caster is also affected. Hollow Frenzy Whenever damage is received: +30 Melee Attack +30 Magic Attack +40 Attack Speed Whenever you damage an enemy: +5% Move Speed +400 Focus +1.5% Damage Taken All effects can stack up to 5 times. Duration Lasts for 12 seconds. Duration increases by +3 seconds per kill up to 19 seconds. 90s cooldown No longer stuns the caster at the end of the duration. Archery Radiant Snare & Radiant Boneyard Radiant Snare Plants a 4m-wide trap beneath your feet. Trap Duration Lasts up to 60 seconds. Ends when an enemy walks over the trap triggering it. Trap Effect When triggered, the trap: Inflicts Snare for 4 seconds. Inflicts Silence for 2 seconds. Affects all enemies within 5m. Reduces Evasion, Block, and Parry by 8%. Maximum Traps Up to 3 Snare Traps can be placed at once. Radiant Boneyard Plants a 4m-wide trap beneath your feet. Trap Duration Lasts up to 60 seconds. Ends when an enemy triggers the trap. Trap Effect When triggered, the trap: Explodes, dealing Ranged Damage to all enemies within 5m. Trips all affected enemies briefly. Confines affected enemies within a Bone Prison. Bone Prison Lasts up to 10 seconds if not destroyed. Maximum Traps Up to 2 Boneyard Traps can be placed at once. Hollow Deadeye The damage bonus is removed if you remain stationary for at least 1 second. Deadeye becomes more powerful as you continue moving, up to +160 Ranged Attack. Movement stacks accumulate while Deadeye is active, up to 30 stacks. Upon reaching 30 stacks, your next Snipe will have no cast time. Duration Deadeye lasts for 60 seconds. Sorcery Radiant Insulating Lens Encases the player in a block of ice for 5 seconds. While encased: Immune to Damage. Immune to Crowd Control. Immune to Negative Effects. Cannot receive Healing. 3m cooldown. Can be activated while affected by any Crowd Control effect. The skill's duration cannot be cancelled early. Hollow Searing Rain Rains down fire on all enemies within a 10m radius for 7 seconds, dealing Magic Damage. Casting Can be cast at a target location up to 20m away. Each instance of damage stacks Searing Slow. Searing Slow: Lowers the movement speed of enemies hit by Searing Rain by 15%. Stacks up to 10, lasts for 5 seconds. 39s cooldown. The caster is NOT immune to crowd control effects while channeling. Vitalism Radiant Revive Grants Nui's Salvation to a target for 5 seconds. If the target would otherwise die during this period, they are saved from death and granted Nui's Divinity. Cooldown Radiant Revive has no cooldown. If a life is saved, this effect cannot be used again on the same target for 5 minutes. Nui's Salvation Upon certain death: Grants the target immortality and gives them Nui's Divinity. Nui's Divinity While active: Immune to Damage. Immune to Debuffs. Cannot move. Cannot perform actions. Lasts for 5 seconds. Death's Judgement At the end of the 5 seconds, Death intervenes, weighing the target's return to the mortal realm. If the target is less than 50% health, Death inflicts Resurrection Sickness on the target for 15 minutes. If the target is less than 80% health, Death will inflict a random curse on the target, lasting for 30 seconds. Resurrection Sickness: -500 melee, ranged and magic attack and healing power. Curses: One of the following curses is picked randomly: 100% increased Abyssal charge decay -3 maximum Abyssal charges -50% movement speed Hollow Renewal Calls forth energy from the land to curse an enemy for 30 seconds. Whenever the cursed enemy receives damage: Has a 2% chance for the stored energy to erupt. Releases a wave of healing that heals all allies within 4m. The healing wave benefits from healing stats. Has no cooldown, similar to base Renewal. Shadowplay Radiant Stalker's Mark Inflicts Ranged Damage marking an enemy for 15s and pushing them back. Damage is reduced by 20% if the target is within 8m. Attacks against the marked target from the initial caster, pushes them backward. The knockback effect can occur once every 2 seconds. 27s cooldown. Hollow Throw Dagger (Currently Disabled.) Changes the damage type of Throw Dagger based on the equipped weapon: Dagger: Ranged Damage Scepter: Magic Damage Bloodthirst Consumes Bloodthirst stacks when used. Gains 1 additional target per Bloodthirst stack consumed. Songcraft Radiant Loudspeaker Increases the range of the following skills to 30m: Quickstep Ode to Recovery Bloody Chantey Bulwark Ballad Grief's Cadence Hollow Critical Discord Deals Magic Damage to up to 10 nearby enemies within a 5m radius around the caster. Inflicts Charmed for 8 seconds. 18s cooldown. Casting Normally has a 3-second cast time. Becomes instant if the caster has 15 stacks of Rhythm. Auramancy Radiant Meditate Grants the caster a buff that regenerates 8% Mana every second. Duration Lasts for 8 seconds. Additional Effect When the buff ends: Resets the cooldown of Teleport. Resets the cooldown of Mirror Warp. 2m cooldown. Hollow Comet's Boon Fires three flashes of light in a cone. Deals Magic Damage to all enemies hit. Increases Move Speed of allies it passes through. Inspires allies it passes through. Slows enemies it passes through. 12s cooldown. All positive effects affect the caster as well. Defense Radiant Mettle While under the effects of Refreshment or Toughen, hits greater than 1000 while below 50% maximum health grant a stack of Radiant Mettle. Can stack up to 5 times. Lasts for 9 seconds. Each stack grants: Effect Bonus Shield Block Rate +3% Damage Converted to Health +3% Chance to Evade Magic +3% Radiant Mettle does NOT replace regular Mettle. You will gain both stacks of Mettle independently. Hollow Ollo's Hammer Summons Ollo's Shield and hurls it toward a target location. Impact Effect If the shield hits an enemy: Inflicts Disarm for 3 seconds. Deals Physical Damage to enemies within 3m of the target location. 42s cooldown. Shield Effect Once the shield lands: Emanates a protective shield once per second. Protects all allies within the area for up to 3,000 damage. Occultism Radiant Mana Force Pulls an enemy or an ally toward the caster, dealing Magic Damage. Restores Mana equal to 50% of the damage dealt. Cooldown is reduced to 30 seconds. Can be cast 3 times in a row. Pulls the target 10m. Range is extended to 25m. 30s cooldown. Hollow Absorb Lifeforce Inflicts a debuff that deals Magic Damage to the enemy over 5 seconds. Heals the caster for 50% of the damage dealt. Deals an additional 140% damage to pets. Penetrates immunity effects on pets. The debuff ends early if the target moves 20m away from the caster. No longer a channeled ability. Works like Crippling Mire. Death's Beckoning adds +2 targets. Witchcraft Radiant Play Dead Allows the caster to play dead to escape danger. Breaks the caster free from Snared effects. Breaks the caster free from Slowed effects. Breaks the caster free from Lassitude effects. Heals 8% HP and Mana per second if the caster is under 50%. Caster is untargetable for 5 seconds. 2m cooldown. All effects end with movement. Hollow Focal Concussion Deals Magic Damage and Stuns an enemy for 1.5 seconds. 27s cooldown. If the target has any positive buffs: Removes 3 positive buffs. Deals additional damage when the Stun ends. Baleful Recharge Removes 1 additional positive buff when stunning the target for each stack of Baleful Recharge. Miscellaneous Changes The Main Story Questline has been changed. Quests after The Riven Gates have been revamped to focus on Classic-style gear start; rather than the current Obsidian Crafting ‘tutorial’ that was generally seen as a newbie trap. New players will now be guided through a custom questline involving acquiring their Hasla Emerald weapon and synthesizing it. Currently the questline leads the player until they acquire a celestial Hasla Emerald weapon while helping them along each step with guidance and rewards. We recommend all new players to thoroughly read through the quest descriptions and if they still have any questions, ask in the new player help channel in our discord server! The main questline will keep getting expanded upon to improve the new player experience and make the first experience smoother. The East Nui in Sungold Fields has been moved closer to Sungold Crimson Rift. Nuis in Exeloch have been moved closer to the purification zone.

  • When you’ve successfully filled the beast’s HP bar, it will accept you as its new owner and you will gain a Mysterious Beast. The type of beast is determined by the creature you’ve just tamed. If it was a boar, you’ll get a Mysterious Boar.

      • Hasty
      • Resolute

    • Species:

If the target is less than 50% health, Death inflicts Resurrection Sickness on the target for 15 minutes. If the target is less than 80% health, Death will inflict a random curse on the target, lasting for 30 seconds.

Resurrection Sickness:

  • -500 melee, ranged and magic attack and healing power.

Curses:

  • One of the following curses is picked randomly:
    • 100% increased Abyssal charge decay
    • -3 maximum Abyssal charges
    • -50% movement speed

Hollow Renewal

Calls forth energy from the land to curse an enemy for 30 seconds.

Whenever the cursed enemy receives damage:

  • Has a 2% chance for the stored energy to erupt.
  • Releases a wave of healing that heals all allies within 4m.
  • The healing wave benefits from healing stats.

Has no cooldown, similar to base Renewal.

Shadowplay

Radiant Stalker's Mark

Inflicts Ranged Damage marking an enemy for 15s and pushing them back.

  • Damage is reduced by 20% if the target is within 8m.
  • Attacks against the marked target from the initial caster, pushes them backward.
  • The knockback effect can occur once every 2 seconds.
  • 27s cooldown.

Hollow Throw Dagger (Currently Disabled.)

Changes the damage type of Throw Dagger based on the equipped weapon:

  • Dagger: Ranged Damage
  • Scepter: Magic Damage

Bloodthirst

Consumes Bloodthirst stacks when used.

  • Gains 1 additional target per Bloodthirst stack consumed.

Songcraft

Radiant Loudspeaker

Increases the range of the following skills to 30m:

  • Quickstep
  • Ode to Recovery
  • Bloody Chantey
  • Bulwark Ballad
  • Grief's Cadence

Hollow Critical Discord

Deals Magic Damage to up to 10 nearby enemies within a 5m radius around the caster.

  • Inflicts Charmed for 8 seconds.
  • 18s cooldown.

Casting

  • Normally has a 3-second cast time.
  • Becomes instant if the caster has 15 stacks of Rhythm.

Auramancy

Radiant Meditate

Grants the caster a buff that regenerates 8% Mana every second.

Duration

  • Lasts for 8 seconds.

Additional Effect

When the buff ends:

  • Resets the cooldown of Teleport.
  • Resets the cooldown of Mirror Warp.
  • 2m cooldown.

Hollow Comet's Boon

Fires three flashes of light in a cone.

  • Deals Magic Damage to all enemies hit.
  • Increases Move Speed of allies it passes through.
  • Inspires allies it passes through.
  • Slows enemies it passes through.
  • 12s cooldown.

All positive effects affect the caster as well.

Defense

Radiant Mettle

While under the effects of Refreshment or Toughen, hits greater than 1000 while below 50% maximum health grant a stack of Radiant Mettle.

  • Can stack up to 5 times.
  • Lasts for 9 seconds.

Each stack grants:

Effect Bonus
Shield Block Rate +3%
Damage Converted to Health +3%
Chance to Evade Magic +3%

Radiant Mettle does NOT replace regular Mettle. You will gain both stacks of Mettle independently.

Hollow Ollo's Hammer

Summons Ollo's Shield and hurls it toward a target location.

Impact Effect

If the shield hits an enemy:

  • Inflicts Disarm for 3 seconds.
  • Deals Physical Damage to enemies within 3m of the target location.
  • 42s cooldown.

Shield Effect

Once the shield lands:

  • Emanates a protective shield once per second.
  • Protects all allies within the area for up to 3,000 damage.

Occultism

Radiant Mana Force

Pulls an enemy or an ally toward the caster, dealing Magic Damage.

  • Restores Mana equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
  • Cooldown is reduced to 30 seconds.
  • Can be cast 3 times in a row.
  • Pulls the target 10m.
  • Range is extended to 25m.
  • 30s cooldown.

Hollow Absorb Lifeforce

Inflicts a debuff that deals Magic Damage to the enemy over 5 seconds.

  • Heals the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.
  • Deals an additional 140% damage to pets.
  • Penetrates immunity effects on pets.
  • The debuff ends early if the target moves 20m away from the caster.

No longer a channeled ability. Works like Crippling Mire. Death's Beckoning adds +2 targets.

Witchcraft

Radiant Play Dead

Allows the caster to play dead to escape danger.

  • Breaks the caster free from Snared effects.
  • Breaks the caster free from Slowed effects.
  • Breaks the caster free from Lassitude effects.
  • Heals 8% HP and Mana per second if the caster is under 50%.
  • Caster is untargetable for 5 seconds.
  • 2m cooldown.

All effects end with movement.

Hollow Focal Concussion

Deals Magic Damage and Stuns an enemy for 1.5 seconds.

  • 27s cooldown.

If the target has any positive buffs:

  • Removes 3 positive buffs.
  • Deals additional damage when the Stun ends.

Baleful Recharge

  • Removes 1 additional positive buff when stunning the target for each stack of Baleful Recharge.

Miscellaneous Changes

  • The Main Story Questline has been changed.
    • Quests after The Riven Gates have been revamped to focus on Classic-style gear start; rather than the current Obsidian Crafting ‘tutorial’ that was generally seen as a newbie trap.
    • New players will now be guided through a custom questline involving acquiring their Hasla Emerald weapon and synthesizing it.
    • Currently the questline leads the player until they acquire a celestial Hasla Emerald weapon while helping them along each step with guidance and rewards. We recommend all new players to thoroughly read through the quest descriptions and if they still have any questions, ask in the new player help channel in our discord server!
    • The main questline will keep getting expanded upon to improve the new player experience and make the first experience smoother.
  • The East Nui in Sungold Fields has been moved closer to Sungold Crimson Rift.
  • Nuis in Exeloch have been moved closer to the purification zone.

Since there are about 40 Enlightened Accessories, each with their own scaling factors, we encourage our players to use the in-game Item Encyclopedia to see all of the new values for themselves. == New Profession: Taming [[News/1.3.6 Preview - Taming|(Preview)]] == [[File:News blog-taming-taming thumbnail.png|center|700px|alt=banner]] * Taming has been added as a new profession. * Taming is the first custom profession that is being added to Archeage Classic. This profession will fall under “Special” Category and revolve around taming wild beasts out in the world, either using these as your own personal mounts, trading them with other players or exchanging them for materials used in various different crafting recipes. * There are two ways to find wild beasts to tame. ** 1- By roaming Erenor and finding wild, wandering tameable beasts ** 2- By instigating tameable beasts to come out of their hiding by slaughtering their kind * Almost every zone in Erenor has wild beasts to tame, so explore and catch them all! * To start taming, you need a Tamer’s backpack, a simple leather-bound bag filled to the brim with crucial tools to tame beasts. ** Currently, there are 3 tiers of backpacks: *** Greenhorn’s Backpack: Requires 0 Taming proficiency to use **** To craft this backpack, you need: ***** 5x Vita Seed ***** 10x Leather ***** 10x Apple *** Wrangler’s Backpack: Requires 80.000 Taming proficiency to use **** To craft this backpack, you need: ***** 1x Greenhorn’s Backpack ***** 10x Hay Bale ***** 10x Apricot ***** 10x Orange ***** 10x Pomegranate ***** 200x Whistle of the Wild (These will be explained later) *** Herdmaster’s Backpack: Requires 200.000 Taming proficiency to use **** To craft this backpack, you need: ***** 1x Greenhorn’s Backpack ***** 10x Royal Seed ***** 5x Wind Spirit Leather ***** 100x Cherry ***** 100x Jujube ***** 100x Coconut ***** 600x Whistle of the Wild * Taming is similar to fishing in terms of mechanics but has a little more depth. * When you attempt to tame a wild beast you will notice its HP drop drastically at first. That’s your progress bar to tame the beast. * The beast may display several “moods” during the taming process. React in time with the correct action and you will gain its trust and come closer to taming it. * When you’ve successfully filled the beast’s HP bar, it will accept you as its new owner and you will gain a Mysterious Beast. The type of beast is determined by the creature you’ve just tamed. If it was a boar, you’ll get a Mysterious Boar. * When you’ve successfully filled the beast’s HP bar, you will receive a Mysterious Beast in your inventory. There are a few extra modifiers fully dependent on luck, they are: * Rarities: ** Your mysterious boar can currently be one of three grades: *** Grand > 9.0 m/s *** Arcane > 11.5 m/s *** Celestial > 11.7 m/s * Personalities: ** Your mount can have one of four personalities: *** Ferocious *** Hasty *** Resolute *** Spunky * These personalities determine your mount’s last three abilities. The first 2 abilities of each mount are unaffected by personality and are unique to each species. ** Species: *** As stated above, species determine the mount’s first 2 abilities. * Once you have your Mysterious Beast, there are a couple of things you can do with it. Let’s use a real example for the sake of simplicity. We just received an Arcane Mysterious Boar from taming a wild boar. ** Right now your Arcane Mysterious Boar is not yet a mount, it is a sealed, tamed beast. Right now, the only thing you know about it is its base movement speed and its first 2 abilities. In its current form, you may trade it with other players or place it on the auction house. ** If you prefer to keep it to yourself as a mount then you can unveil your mount to reveal its personality. Upon unveiling your Arcane Mysterious Beast, it can have any of the 4 personalities available. *** Ferocious *** Hasty *** Resolute *** Spunky * As stated earlier, the first 2 abilities of your mount are predetermined by its species. The last 3 abilities are determined by its personality. Each personality has 3 abilities. * From the 3rd ability slot to the 5th, each slot is a 50/50 between one ability from its personality pool and one ability from its species. * With these in mind, I’m sure you can imagine how many different combinations there are available. * Without listing all available abilities, you can think of each personality as a unique archetype: ** Ferocious has abilities that are offensive and damage oriented. ** Hasty abilities are focused on speed and covering a lot of distance. ** Resolute’s ability pool is all about being tanky and surviving as long as possible. ** Spunky has abilities that are mostly movement oriented. * Your last option with your new mount is to release it back into the wild using a Wildcaller Flute, available for purchase from any stablehand. ** When a mount is released using the Wildcaller Flute, you are granted Whistles of the Wild. The exact amount varies depending on the rarity of the mount released. *** On average: **** Grand mounts yield ~3 Whistle of the Wild **** Arcane mounts yield ~5 Whistle of the Wild **** Celestial mounts yield ~10 Whistle of the Wild **** These whistles are crucial to taming as almost every crafting recipe requires them in some amount. * On top of already extremely customizable mounts, we have added new custom mount armor sets as well. ** Each set has 3 pieces; Shaffron (head slot), Saddle (body slot) and Cannonguards (legs slot). If you have any ideas you would like to suggest, please feel free to make a game suggestion thread in our discord server. == Primal Anthalon [[News/1.3.6 Preview - Primal Anthalon|(Preview)]] == [[File:News aac primal anth thumbnail-0dc5aa.png|center|700px|alt=banner]] * Primal Anthalon is the latest Primal world boss added to Archeage Classic. * For these patch notes, we have decided not to explain all of the new mechanics Primal Anthalon now has, instead focusing on the new Primal Kyrios armor set and set effects. However, that being said, we would like to briefly mention and name a few of the new mechanics: ** Festival of the Dead has gotten a significant boost. It is said Anthalon has gotten his hands on some particularly strong undead minions. ** Anthalon has infused his signature ability, Absorb Mind, with the power of the Comet. It is now deadlier and much more potent. Now powered up with powerful undead chanters chanting words of binding, it will be quite a challenge to break free of his grasp. ** With the Comet’s influence strong on Exeloch, Anthalon has managed to summon spires of immense power, biding his time to gather his strength further. Whatever he may be up to, is no good… * Added Primal Kyrios armor set. ** Ilvl has been boosted to 62. (Equivalent to Ayanad) ** Stat allocations on certain pieces have been adjusted. *** Primal Kyrios Shirt is now full Stamina rather than Stamina / Intelligence *** Primal Kyrios Sleeves are now full Intelligence rather than Stamina / Intelligence *** Primal Kyrios Gloves are now Stamina / Intelligence rather than full Intelligence *** Primal Kyrios Sash is now full Intelligence rather than Stamina / Intelligence *** Primal Kyrios Pants are now full Stamina rather than Full Intelligence. ** 4 and 7-set effects have been adjusted. *** 4-set: **** Grants 700 toughness. **** There’s a low chance to trigger Anthalon’s Necromantic Flame upon receiving damage. *** 7-set: **** Decreases damage received by 4.5% **** Has a low chance of triggering Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb upon dealing any damage. **** Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb is a new ability. **** Upon triggering Primal Anthalon’s Mind Absorb, the player is granted “Instant Acceleration for 3 minutes. ***** During the 3 minutes, the player can cast Instant Acceleration to teleport to any target within 20 meters.
